name: Adhan
summary: A grounded mosque dome sends a clear call outward through two generous sound strokes.
why: The low dome, visible entrance, and broad base establish a mosque. Two restrained outward curves express the adhan. Ivory architecture and warm gold give the violet tile a calm but recognizable prayer identity.
risk: It can also suggest mosque audio or adhan playback. At very small sizes the entrance becomes a detail, while the dome and outward call remain the main shapes.
sub2: A reminder to pause for prayer
reasonToChoose: Prayer reminders should be the strongest first impression.
